fields.name: keyword
fields.description: Google search keyword, passed as the q= parameter to initiate a Google AI Mode search. Only supports single-turn conversation; follow-up prompts are not supported. To ask follow-up questions, the agent must independently summarize key information from the previous AI overview, concatenate the new question, and send it as a new keyword in a new request
fields.example: best phone case material for iPhone

example.keyword: best phone case material for iPhone
